# ChiptuneSynth — AI-Friendly Summary

> Zero-dependency 8-bit chiptune synthesizer for the browser. Pure Web Audio API.

## About

ChiptuneSynth is an open-source browser-native chiptune synthesizer built with the Web Audio API. Zero dependencies, works in any modern browser. Created by 8Binami.

## Features

- 4 tracks with independent controls
- 12 instruments: square, sine, triangle, sawtooth, pulse, noise, metallic, bass, lead, pad, arp, custom
- 10 SFX presets: coin, jump, powerup, hit, laser, explosion, select, pause, gameover, levelup
- ADSR envelopes per instrument
- Vibrato / LFO modulation
- MIDI input support
- Arpeggiator with multiple patterns
- Unison and filter controls

## Installation

```bash
npm install @8bitforge/chiptune-synth
```

## Quick Start

```javascript
import { ChiptuneSynth } from '@8bitforge/chiptune-synth';

const synth = new ChiptuneSynth();
synth.playPreset('coin');
```

## Technical

- 100% browser-native (Web Audio API)
- Zero dependencies
- ES module compatible
- TypeScript declarations included

## Languages

English, Spanish, Chinese, Portuguese, Japanese, German, French, Korean, Italian, Russian
